comparison_notes: Seeds vary paired minibatch order. Every arm starts at identity with zero per-feature gates; no random adapter initialization or endpoint selection.

The no-adapter frozen model is the shared zero-update baseline. Pointwise uses 768 parameters; fixed GL has 768 trainable plus one frozen order scalar; learned GL has 769 trainable parameters. This is not an exactly parameter-matched or compute-matched claim.
Fixed and learned GL use the same public Rust map, step 1, kernel length 32 and initial alpha 0.5. The fixed arm freezes log_alpha. Python does not reconstruct fractional mathematics.

Primary contrasts: fixed GL minus pointwise for history, and learned GL minus fixed GL for order adaptation. Both history compute and scalar flexibility can matter; a quality difference is not proof of unique geometric advantage.
Complete all nine 512-update runs and exact next-update continuation before endpoint evaluation. Development scores do not select hyperparameters, checkpoints or run length.
